recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is recommended for FHIR-32791 unless a future work group decision changes DocumentReference.content cardinality or narrows Attachment.url semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-32791 asked to loosen the required DocumentReference.content element, or otherwise provide guidance for creating a DocumentReference that only references a Composition. The Published resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: FHIR-37444 established that Attachment.url can point at a Resource, so DocumentReference.content.attachment.url can point at a Composition or document Bundle and an example should be added instead of changing cardinality.
initial_application: The source change was applied by ee4b4a76e229bdcb8acff98a0cbe97a07ff0d935, merged by PR #2087, which added DocumentReference examples for content.attachment.url pointing at a Composition and at a document Bundle and registered those examples in list-DocumentReference-examples.xml. Later QA and example-list commits preserved the Composition example.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini, so its source folder and examples are in build scope. The current StructureDefinition still has DocumentReference.content as 1..*, matching the not-persuasive cardinality decision. The Attachment datatype text says relative URLs are interpreted like resource references and may resolve within a Bundle. FHIR-37444, OO/FHIR-I minutes, and Zulip discussion consistently support using Attachment.url for Composition or Bundle resources without a datatype change.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source edit is needed. The requested example is already present and registered, and the authoritative datatype/source text already supports the selected mechanism.

related_jiras.note: Resolved No Change question confirming DocumentReference.content.attachment.url may point at a document Bundle/resource; this was the basis for the FHIR-32791 no-cardinality-change resolution.
